WITH PlaylistCounts AS (
    SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS TrackCount
    FROM Playlist p
    LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
    GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
),
AverageCount AS (
    SELECT AVG(TrackCount * 1.0) AS AvgTrackCount
    FROM PlaylistCounts
)
SELECT pc.PlaylistId,
       pc.TrackCount,
       pc.TrackCount * 1.0 / NULLIF(ac.AvgTrackCount, 0) AS Ratio
FROM PlaylistCounts pc
CROSS JOIN AverageCount ac
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ac.AvgTrackCount IS NULL OR ac.AvgTrackCount = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         Ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
